summary: Frontend-only verification of the new multi-association 'Comptes liés' feature on the Next.js web app (/app/web). All 5 requested checks PASS. Login as admin@delete-test.local / admin123 on association DELETE-TEST works, /settings loads cleanly (no JS errors on the page, only two harmless '[PAGE ERROR] Incorrect locale information provided' from Next.js dev/turbopack which are unrelated to this feature). The 'Comptes liés' card renders with data-testid='linked-accounts-card', title 'Comptes liés' + Users icon. The 'Ajouter un compte' button (data-testid='add-account-btn') is present and visible with correct label. Because only ONE linked account exists (auto-seeded from the current session), the switch/remove list is correctly hidden (0 elements matching [data-testid^='switch-account-'] and [data-testid^='remove-account-']) and the helper text 'Ajoutez un compte pour gérer plusieurs associations sans vous déconnecter.' is shown. localStorage.linkedAccounts is populated with the current session {token,user,association} (backward-compat init from AuthContext.checkAuth confirmed). Clicking 'Ajouter un compte' navigates to /login where the association selector is displayed (DELETE-TEST visible), enabling the user to log into a second association without losing the current session — matching the Gmail-style multi-account flow.
critical_code_review_comments: web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx switchAccount(): does NOT reset selectedAssociation on the axios interceptor / TanStack Query cache. After switch, react-query cached data from previous association (config, years, members) will still be shown until the queries refetch or the user hard-refreshes. Recommend calling queryClient.clear() (or invalidateQueries) inside switchAccount OR after the router.push in handleSwitchAccount to force fresh data for the new association.

web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: on login() the new session token overwrites localStorage.authToken, but the OLD linked account's token stays in localStorage.linkedAccounts. If that old token expires, switchAccount() silently reactivates an expired token and /auth/me will 401 — no visual feedback. Consider a token-validity check in switchAccount() (call /auth/me before setUser) and, on 401, offer to re-login for that account.

web/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx logout() removes ALL linkedAccounts. This may surprise users who click 'Se déconnecter' expecting only the current session to end. Consider (a) renaming logout to 'logoutAll' + adding a 'logoutCurrent' that only removes the active account and switches to the next, or (b) confirming with a modal 'Se déconnecter de tous les comptes liés ?'.

web/src/app/settings/page.tsx handleRemoveLinkedAccount(): checks linkedAccounts.length <= 1 AFTER calling removeLinkedAccount(); by that time state hasn't updated (React state is async) so the router.push('/login') triggers only when the previous length was 1, which is the desired behaviour — but the condition reads awkwardly. Move the redirect logic inside AuthContext.removeLinkedAccount (it already calls logout() when updatedAccounts.length===0, so page-level router.push('/login') is redundant + could race).

web/src/app/settings/page.tsx: handleSwitchAccount / handleRemoveLinkedAccount pass account.association?.id which could be undefined; TS should reject the call to switchAccount(associationId: string). Consider adding a guard `if (!account.association?.id) return;`.

Mobile parity note: /app/frontend/context/AuthContext.js was listed as reference but not exercised (React Native — Playwright cannot run it). Code review only: same design; verify that AsyncStorage 'linkedAccounts' key uses JSON.stringify/parse and that switchAccount refreshes the offline cache keys keyed by member/admin id (see iteration_13 comment about OfflineContext cache duplication).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 requested checks — settings shows Comptes liés card, add-account button present + visible, single-account helper text shown, no accounts list when linkedAccounts.length===1, click navigates to /login; login flow unchanged)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing DELETE-TEST association + admin account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Next.js web app at /app/web is NOT under supervisor; start it manually before UI testing: `cd /app/web && nohup yarn dev --port 3002 > /tmp/web.log 2>&1 &` (port 3002 is CORS-whitelisted; the supervisor 'expo' service on :3000 is the React Native mobile app, do not confuse them). Backend runs on :8001 via supervisor. Web reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8001 from /app/web/.env.local. To test multi-account switching end-to-end you need TWO admin accounts on TWO different associations — currently only admin@delete-test.local (DELETE-TEST) has a known password; ascb@drigo.local password is unknown per test_credentials.md. To exercise the switch/remove UI you must first create/login a second association (e.g. via /creer-association) then return to /settings — the switch-account-<id> and remove-account-<id> data-testids will then be present.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found. The two Next.js '[PAGE ERROR] Incorrect locale information provided' console errors are dev-only artefacts from turbopack + Intl formatting on the /login and /settings pages; they do not affect functionality. Consider passing an explicit locale (e.g. 'fr-FR') to any Intl.NumberFormat/DateTimeFormat calls to silence them.
